paragraphs: The F-Pace D300 has been part of the F-Pace range since 2016, using the Ingenium AJ300D - a 3.0-litre inline-six diesel MHEV. It's the most powerful diesel in the F-Pace line-up, positioned above the D200. The AJ300D is a six-cylinder member of Jaguar Land Rover's Ingenium family, sharing its core architecture with the four-cylinder AJ200D fitted to other F-Pace and XE/XF models. The D300 badge replaced the earlier 3.0-litre V6 diesel found in pre-2019 F-Pace models, moving to a more modern inline-six configuration with mild-hybrid assistance. The F-Pace D300 remains in production as a current variant.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace AJ300D (Ingenium) engines for every F-Pace D300 on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six diesel MHEV fitted to the F-Pace D300 from 2016 to present across the X761 generation. Known for timing chain wear as part of the broader Ingenium diesel pattern - see the callout above. We replace the timing chain, tensioners, guides, injector seals, bearings and gaskets as standard on every AJ300D rebuild.
